description: Captured from `node extension/server.mjs` on a temp DB (LLMIDE_DB_PATH in TMPDIR, LLMIDE_ENGINE_PREWARM=0), replayed over HTTP and seeded through the API. The model text is a canned local stub (LLMIDE_ANTHROPIC_CLI, a script that prints the CLI result object), so no model call is made. Plan generation runs the planner and the risk pass (two stub calls), then code-sync (no code graph in the temp DB, so files and symbols are empty). The plan ids are generated by the server, so their values are examples.
